part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `DropMetricName` (model/labels/labels.go:353): `append(ls[:i], ls[i+1:]...)` shifted elements in the shared backing array in place, corrupting other `Labels` values aliasing the same slice during range-query evaluation. The fix limits capacity with `ls[:i:i]` so `append` allocates a new slice instead.

Verified: `go test ./promql/ ./model/labels/` (including `TestRangeQuery` and `TestLabels_DropMetricName`) all pass.
